question.text: Reporting by Category I/II AIFs includes:

answer.text: Periodic investor disclosures of financial, risk, operational, portfolio, and transactional information; annual investor reports with financial information and material risks; and quarterly activity reports to SEBI
Only the fund manager's personal tax returns

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook requires periodic investor disclosures of financial, risk-management, operational, portfolio, and transactional information; annual investor reports that include financial information and material risks such as leverage and realisation risk; and quarterly activity reports to SEBI. The Trap: Not every disclosure item is necessarily made on both a quarterly and an annual basis — quarterly cadence specifically applies to the SEBI activity reports. Note: Based on workbook pages 205 and 210-212 covering investor disclosures, annual reporting, and quarterly SEBI activity reports.
